rationale.risk-routing: Confidence-and-impact-aware routing triages which cases reach human review
rationale.ai-review: AI judges documents; divergence detection via second model, reliability limits
rationale.provenance-auditability: Provenance capture, causal traces, appeal bundles for human/court review
rationale.org-governance: Goals ledger, audit logging, roles, versioning, change control apparatus
rationale.rules-based-checks: Conformance pattern uses machine-checkable hard constraints and rules checker
rationale.framework: Reference architecture: mechanism catalogue plus four end-to-end oversight patterns
rationale.design-only: Architectural design specified, never built or evaluated by authors
rationale.general-ai: Oversight framework targets general AI, not coding-specific; medical/policy examples
rationale.counterpoint: Argues against zero-sum oversight and checklist-compliance framing of oversight
